HR self service

Please ensure all your details are up to date by logging in to self service to check your:

  • bank details
  • emergency contact details
  • personal details, including address and contact phone number

Payslips are available on self service two working days before payday. For a list of pay dates and other useful information, visit the pay and pensions webpage.

HR self service downtime: Monday 29 June to Thursday 2 July 2026

As part of a project to move our current HR and Payroll system (ResourceLink) from an onsite setup to a cloud-based version with the same provider, HR self service will be unavailable from late Monday 29 June, aiming to be available again from Thursday 2 July 2026.

To find out what this means for all staff, including managers, visit the HR self-service page.
